newsitem.title: USA: Limited sees year EPS below mean estimate.
newsitem.headline: Limited sees year EPS below mean estimate.

text.p: Limited Inc said Thursday it expects earnings per share for the year ending this month to be slightly short of the First Call mean estimate.
It did not provide the mean estimate, but according to First Call, analysts' consensus earnings estimate is $1.17 per share for the year, versus $0.87 in the previous year.

In making its earnings forecast, Limited cited unexpectedly poor December sales at its Express division. It said a number of initiatives for 1997 will be announced in the next week. It gave no details.
